profile.heading: Who is Shu Chen?
profile.tldr: Shu Chen (陈术) is a software engineer and developer based in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. He studies Software Engineering at the University of Ottawa (uOttawa) and builds AI agents, retrieval-augmented (RAG) systems, and fintech products. He is available for software engineering roles across Canada, including Ottawa, Toronto, Montreal, Waterloo, and Vancouver, as well as remote.

faq.a: Shu Chen (陈术) is a software engineer and developer based in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. He is a third-year Software Engineering student at the University of Ottawa who builds AI agents, RAG systems, and fintech tools. This is the portfolio of Shu Chen the Canadian software developer — not the actor or musician who share the name.

Shu Chen is based in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. He is available for software engineering roles across Canada — in person in Ottawa, Toronto, Montreal, Waterloo, and Vancouver, or remote anywhere in Canada. He is a Canadian citizen / permanent resident authorized to work in Canada with no sponsorship required.

faq.q: Is Shu Chen a software developer?
faq.a: Yes. Shu Chen is a full-stack and AI developer. His stack spans Python, TypeScript, React, and Next.js on the front end and back end, plus Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Docker for cloud and infrastructure. He has shipped AI to production, including an agentic RAG system used by roughly 21,000 employees.

Shu Chen builds AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and fintech tools. His projects include Algolite, which turns a plain-English trading idea into runnable, backtestable Python, and Stockmails, an automated daily financial-news digest. He is also the engineer behind a live commercial website.

faq.q: How can I contact Shu Chen?
faq.a: The best way to reach Shu Chen is through LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/scscscscsc or this portfolio at shuchen.ca. To protect his privacy, his phone number and email are not published on this site, but recruiters and collaborators can connect with him through his public profiles.

about.metaTitle: About Shu Chen — Software Developer in Ottawa, Ontario
about.metaDescription: About Shu Chen (陈术), a software engineer and developer in Ottawa, Canada: AI, hardware, music, and applying CS and math to markets since age sixteen.
about.tldr: Shu Chen is a software engineer in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada who builds software and hardware — AI agents and fintech tools by day, and a self-built Voron 3D printer, a dozen instruments, and machine-learning-for-markets on the side.
paragraphs: Shu Chen is a software engineer in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada who enjoys building software and hardware products—both professionally and as a hobby. He likes turning ideas into things people can use, whether that means shipping at work or tinkering on his own time.

Outside of engineering, he is deeply into music. He plays more than a dozen instruments—including piano, trombone, and saxophone—and has performed at jazz gigs in and around Ottawa, as well as charity concerts for senior homes and similar community events.

He is also drawn to technology beyond his day job: he has been exploring machine learning and AI for years, and he designed and built a high-performance 3D printer entirely on his own. He has a strong interest in finance and in applying computer science and mathematics to markets—a pursuit he has carried since he was sixteen and continues today.
